_howto: Single source of truth for the site. To update a paper: change status (in-preparation | under-review | published), add doi, zenodo and github when they exist. Never put results of papers under review here, only topic and status. TRL ranges confirmed by the author on 2026-11-22.

lines.name: Droplets and solidification

lines.name: Desalination and membrane distillation
lines.summary: Direct-contact and air-gap membrane distillation at module scale, heat recovery, multi-objective optimisation and a cost-comparison tool for desalination technologies.
lines.summary_pt: Destilação por membranas em contato direto e com gap de ar em escala de módulo, recuperação térmica, otimização multiobjetivo e ferramenta de análise de custos entre tecnologias de dessalinização.

lines.name: Membraneless alkaline electrolysis
lines.summary: Design, construction and theoretical–experimental analysis of a modular membraneless flow-by electrolyzer with nickel foam electrodes: stabilization, two-phase CFD, outlet-gas analysis and chloride-containing electrolyte.
